// Positive control (#5170): inside the unreadable arm the outcome reaches the verdict builder through a
// variable — the guard cannot prove it is `'unreadable'`, so it is flagged.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  const plan = readTextEvidence(planPath);
  if (plan.kind === 'unreadable') {
    const outcome = 'pass';
    return gateVerdict(outcome, false, { reason: plan.reason });
  }
  return gateVerdict('pass', false, {});
}
